title: Bar Series Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Series’ Banana Ice delivers the classic, creamy taste of Banana with a fresh and frosty twist. Smooth, rich and delicately sweet, the taste of banana is finished with a subtle dash of menthol for a crisp, icy finish. Great for vapers who enjoy straightforward fruit flavours with a refreshing hint of menthol. Banana Ice is one of more than 40 flavours in the Bar Series collection, a range of nic salt e-liquids that mimic the intense flavours found in the most popular disposable vapes. Unlike single-use disposable vape bars, however, Bar Series 10ml e-liquids provide up to five times the vaping enjoyment and are compatible with a huge variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape devices. This makes them a versatile and convenient alternative to disposables, and one that is kinder to both your wallet and the environment. Bar Series Nic Salts contain a perfectly balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, which makes them ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter vape kits and pod devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these Nic Salt e-liquids offer a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine delivery than traditional freebase e-liquids, making them a great choice for adult smokers and vapers looking for fast and flavoursome nicotine relief. The Bar Series collection contains over 40 flavours in the Bar Series collection, from juicy fruits in intriguing blends to dessert-inspired vapes to, icy menthols, beverages, classic tobaccos and many more! For sub-ohm vapers, we also sell over a dozen of Bar Series’ most popular flavours in long-lasting High-VG 100ml shortfills, ideal for advanced vape kits and sub-ohm devices.
